description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing data access object (DAO) methods related to Claim entities in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes setup for test fixtures, and tests for CRUD operations on ClaimEvent, ExpenseType, and ClaimRequest entities, as well as utility functions like getting the next ID and checking if a claim event is used.

classes.name: ClaimDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing ClaimDao methods within the OrangeHRM claim plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes ClaimDao instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests saving a new ClaimEvent and verifies its name and status.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ClaimEvents based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventById
methods.description: Tests fetching a ClaimEvent by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests deleting ClaimEvents by their IDs.

methods.name: testCountClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests counting ClaimEvents based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testSaveExpenseType
methods.description: Tests saving a new ExpenseType entity.

methods.name: testSaveClaimRequest
methods.description: Tests saving a ClaimRequest linked to a ClaimEvent and CurrencyType.

methods.name: testGetNextId
methods.description: Tests retrieving the next available ID for Claim records.

methods.name: testIsClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Tests checking whether a ClaimEvent is used.
